name: In Sheep's Clothing
description: Q has again taken it upon himself to test his favorite Starfleet personnel! This time, he's decided to pursue unity in the galaxy with a challenge to see the Federation's adversaries the way they see themselves - as the heroes of their own stories!
rules:
-- Unique Augments, Ferengi Traditionalists, and Section 31 Faction Missions are available during the event. Open the Event to access them.
-- Using any version of Q, Tog, Khan, or Playful crew will provide a bonus to Event Faction Missions.
-- Every Event Faction Mission you succeed at earns you Event Victory Points. Collect Victory Points to unlock Event Threshold Rewards.
-- In this event, Squadrons may also compete to advance up the Squadron leaderboards. Join a Squadron to get more rewards!
bonus_text: Crew Bonus: Q, Tog, Khan, Playful
rewards_teaser: Reach Rank 1 by gaining Victory Points from Event Missions!
